fix: Drop the per-group `keys` Vec and the `sort_key.clone()` in widget_sort_key. Change widget_sort_key to return Option<&incular_semantics::OrdinalSortKey> (`.and_then(|explicit| explicit.state.sort_key.as_ref())`), change sort_keys_compatible to take Option<&OrdinalSortKey>, and look keys up from self.elements inside the run loop and sort closure. Also test `group.iter().all(...)` for no keys before doing any work, so the common unkeyed group allocates nothing. Removes a String clone per keyed element and the Vec per group.

fix: Sort each keyed run in place instead of building an index `order` Vec and a `sorted` Vec copied back (lines 1021-1022). Runs are contiguous and all their elements share one sort-key name (or are all unkeyed), so an in-place stable sort of group[run_start..run_end] with the key looked up from self.elements gives the same order and run boundaries. Delete `order`, `sorted` and copy_from_slice. Removes two allocations per sibling group that has more than one child.

scrollable_viewport_chain (interaction.rs:432) builds and returns the whole chain Vec with cloned controllers and physics, and only the first entry is used. Add a `first_scrollable_viewport(&self, element) -> Option<(ElementId, ScrollController, Axis, bool, ScrollPhysics)>` in interaction.rs that runs the same walk and returns on the first push, and call it here. Behaviour is unchanged because only the first element of the chain is read.

Collect the merged label into one String instead of a Vec<String> that is then joined. Thread `out: &mut String` (plus a flag for whether a separator is needed) through push_merged_labels and push each label with a separator. Make element_own_label return Option<Cow<'_, str>> (borrowing the label or text from the widget, Cow::Owned only for the Button widget_text case) so descendant labels are not cloned. Removes a per-label String clone, the Vec and the final join for every MergeSemantics node.

Remove the eager `explicit_description` binding. It clones the explicit description for every visited element, including role-less ones that never emit a SemanticBuild. Inside the emitting branch (line 929) use `.or_else(|| entry.widget.semantic_properties().explicit.as_ref().and_then(|semantics| semantics.description.clone()))` so the clone happens only when a node is emitted and the widget's own description is absent.
Reuse the `focused` value already computed at line 723 (`focused: focused,` or shorthand `focused,`) instead of looking up the same live text-field state a second time in the same arm.
